parsed.reason: Description A says metadata is written before the blob, so a failed blob write or concurrent reader can pair old blob with new metadata (non-atomic two-step update). Description B identifies the mutable default argument `metadata: dict = {}` being shared across calls and mutated by setdefault, causing wrong content-type to persist. Different root causes, though both touch put's metadata handling.
